# Prices are not updating

If prices on the dashboard look stale, check these in order.

## Check your connection

Make sure the backend can reach the internet — price data comes from Yahoo
Finance and CoinGecko.

## Check the ticker

A misspelled or delisted ticker returns no price at all.
